Resize.scope: the exact tested ONNX Resize formulation only; not a universal claim about every Resize form
Resize.observed_reason: RKNN 1.7.5 failed matching Resize_resize_negative and reported the op may not yet be supported; r_resize_check raised IndexError

warp_or_gridsample_like.scope: the exact tested custom WarpLike control representing the warp/GridSample-like class
warp_or_gridsample_like.observed_reason: WarpLike was unregistered; RKNN shape inference raised KeyError/ValueError

network_adjusted_live_deadline_model.interpretation: The modeled 41.5% crossover is optimistic. Resize and warp/reprojection were rejected from the tested RKNN NPU graph and therefore their external execution cost is not represented inside the 9.1570176-GOP NPU graph; any nonzero external cost consumes the already-thin modeled margin. This is a planning model, not measured RV1126 execution time.

throughput_vs_latency_separation.aggregate_fabric_budget: rv1126_video_fabric_f1_budget.csv remains an aggregate/offline throughput-capacity model.
throughput_vs_latency_separation.live_deadline_budget: RV1126_F2_NETWORK_ADJUSTED_LIVE_BUDGET.json is a separate modeled per-frame 60-fps deadline budget.
throughput_vs_latency_separation.forbidden_inference: Do not convert aggregate/offline throughput into a 16.667-ms live-latency claim without measured RV1126 silicon execution evidence.

independent_ubuntu2004_cleanroom.known_legacy_metadata_mismatch: torchvision 0.11.0 requires torch==1.10.0+cu102 in its yanked metadata while Rockchip's CPU requirements pin torch==1.10.0; both runtime modules report +cu102 and import successfully

scope_limits: No RV1126 silicon execution time or latency was measured by these compiler runs.
No simulator, QEMU, GitHub-host CPU time or converter time is treated as RV1126 timing.
Synthetic 7-channel INT8 calibration proves the converter path only; it does not prove neural reconstruction quality.
The tested Resize and WarpLike failures establish this graph boundary, not universal impossibility for every alternative formulation or external accelerator path.
